description.value: A soul-tech accounting core threaded into the sternum, tallying every soul that guttered out near you. Passively banks 1 charge per day from proximity to death (any creature dying or reduced to 0 HP within 30 ft); stores up to 3. Spend a charge, free action, to reroll any check or save and take the better result — but every charge spent is logged and traced back to your exact time and place.

cinderfall.incomplete: The whole ability is a passive charge-banking system (1/day from nearby deaths, up to 3 stored) spent to reroll any check/save -- pf2e has no reroll rule-element key anywhere (confirmed absence, same as every reroll-shaped mutation in the prior pass), and the charge-banking-from-nearby-deaths trigger has no roll-option hook either.
